limitations: L4 means offline synthetic fixture software acceptance, never biological or clinical validation. No measured-data validation, uncertainty interval or dose recommendation is provided.
Hash-bound declarations cannot establish historical freeze timing, source authenticity or true independence. Independent review and rigor remain coordinator-owned; review is unavailable here.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Additional refusals: truth, bioavailab*, safe dose, human exposure, exposure-response (space/hyphen), physical validity. Includes negations and is incomplete for other languages or paraphrases.
Computed records and review approval never support positive claims; unavailable citations require unavailable status. Replicated status is refused for synthetic fixtures.

Raw inputs are bounded to 64 MiB per artifact, 256 MiB per bundle across unique inodes, and 4,000,000 estimated JSON values before parsing. Hashes are rechecked at the end; this is not a transactional filesystem snapshot.
The single frozen terminal window is not automatically optimized. Unreliable terminal estimates remain visible and are excluded entirely from group summaries.
